column1: # The legs of the test gate, as data: bin/test-local.sh builds a plain run's
# plan from this file (in this order), its --parallel mode schedules them, and
# One leg per line, eight tab-separated columns, "-" for an empty one:
#   id        unique name of the row
#   kind      the leg kind run_leg_body runs and --plan prints
#             suite     the whole free and pro suites on one WordPress
#             free      a live group whose plugins all come from WordPress.org
#             licensed  a live group that needs a commercial copy (Mac only;
#                       never run, named in or referenced from CI)
#             extra     run under --all only (the adapter leg)
#   wp        default | floor (the Requires at least WordPress) | - (none)
#   coverage  floor (the coverage floor leg) | none | -
#   groups    the PHPUnit groups the leg runs, comma separated; - for the
#   requires  for licensed legs: the environment variables naming the local
#             copies; any one of them set enables the leg; - otherwise
#   tests     the test files holding the leg's groups, comma separated; - for
#             the whole suite. TestGateTest checks this column against the
# Plugins and versions are not here: bin/install-test-plugins.sh --list is
# their one home, and each leg's summary line names what it ran against.
